EnvImport.description: `{ env = "NAME", default = ... }`: import an environment variable.

default.description: The value when `env` is unset or empty, in the same forms as a definition.

env.description: The environment variable to read, as a list of paths like `PATH`.
Environment variables the script may read.

grants.description: Named grants to apply, which expand to the fields above.

anyOf.description: An array overriding the inherited value.
A table that, with `inherit = true`, appends `value` to the inherited value.

ListField.description: A list field, following Cargo's array-or-table idiom.

anyOf.description: The paths in an environment variable, or a default when it's unset.

Source.description: Where some of a variable's paths come from.

VariableDef.description:
A `[variables]` entry: one source, or an array whose sources all apply.

A variable's value is a list of paths; an array is the union of its
sources' paths.

external.description: Policy for registry and git dependencies.

grant.description: Named grants, overriding built-ins of the same name per field.

limits.description: Consumer caps; constrains only the fields it names.

local.description: Policy for workspace members and path dependencies.

package.description: Per-package policy, overriding the category tables.

variables.description: User-defined path variables, used in policy paths as `:name`.
